prompt:
Single game hero sprite: a stocky heroic dragonkin warrior, a dragon-person about 3 heads tall (draw the head big and the legs short, not a tall lean figure), with a dragon head with two swept-back horns and a short snout, a humanoid body in layered scale-plate armor built from several stacked overlapping plates on the chest, shoulders and belly, strong arms with clawed hands that grip a sword hilt with fingers, short sturdy legs ending in clawed dragon feet, one thick tail growing from the base of the spine with several curling segments, a flowing feathered mane running from the head down the back, and one large wind-swept cape-like wing trailing from the shoulders; the tail, mane and wing are drawn noticeably wider than the torso itself, spreading out behind and above the body; the near right arm is raised holding a curved wind-blade that reaches from the waist to the chest, its tip clearly below the top of the head (blade and hand fully inside the frame), the other arm relaxed at the side; deep teal-blue scales with a bright cyan accent on the mane and wing edges, dark blue-black outline.
SIDE VIEW from a high top-down camera: facing RIGHT toward the right edge of the screen, the whole body and face clearly turned to face RIGHT, the chest turned only about 30 degrees toward the viewer so the face and the front of the chest are visible, the far arm and leg partly hidden behind the body. Not a flat profile, not a front view, not a diagonal three-quarter view toward the bottom-right.
Standing UPRIGHT in a calm neutral idle stance: the body vertical, not leaning and not walking diagonally, both feet side by side on ONE horizontal ground line, the blade held up calmly in the raised near arm (not swinging, not striking). Full body, centered, filling about 70% of the frame; the tail, mane, wing and blade all stay inside the frame with margin on every side.
The face is only a brow line and a small eye slit; hands are simple mitten shapes, visible and holding the weapon (not hidden in sleeves). No buckles, no pouches, no straps beyond one, no rope, no bandages, no spikes, no stitches, no patches, no fabric texture: clothing is a few big flat shapes. At most three colour families.
Background: one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no ground, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no border. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere on the subject.
Stylized 2D vector cartoon game art for a top-down fantasy tower defense game, designed to read at about 84 pixels tall.
Simple design: big clear shapes and a strong silhouette; small details are left out or merged into larger shapes; faces, hands, armour and clothing are suggested with a few lines, never rendered in fine detail.
Stylized, exaggerated cartoon proportions, not realistic anatomy (about 2.5 to 4 heads tall): the parts that express the character's role are enlarged and the rest is shrunk, so the silhouette reads at 84 pixels.
Colour: flat solid fills only, no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no noise, no realistic rendering. Volume and shadow come from 2-3 hard-edged tones of the same colour (shadow, base, light), plus a few small highlight shapes.
Thick clean outlines in a dark shade of the neighbouring colour.
Effects (fire, ice, magic, poison, glow, energy) are drawn as stacked layers of flat single-colour vector shapes with an outline that follows the effect's form (flame tongues, ice shards, drips, sparks), never as soft blur or gradient glow.
High top-down camera tilted about 60 degrees; light comes from the top-left.
